name: Sim-to-sim adaptation test of the SimDist recipe (arXiv 2603.15759): fine-tune ONLY the latent dynamics on a small amount of label-free data from a shifted physics, keep encoder (DINOv2+PCA) and start operator frozen; does the fork monitor recover?
written: 2026-10-24 ~12:00, before any episode in the shifted physics was run
shift: 'real world' = neighbour blocks' mass and inertia x0.3 (MASS_ONLY=0.3 in eval/policy_rollout.py); rendering, layout, policy, 2x execution noise, HARD_OFF=1, per-episode seeds, settle, 60 chunks as the scl test. Light neighbours were out of distribution for an earlier world model (barrier AUC 0.68 vs 0.90 in distribution; results/jenga/cbf_barrier_panels_summary.json)
episodes: policy alone (record arm) in the shifted physics: 30000-30099 = adaptation (about 80 min of robot time), 30100-30399 = evaluation; never used for anything else
adaptation: label-free data: 400 random decisions of the adaptation episodes (no topple-based selection), 8 futures each in the shifted physics, eval/closedloop_data.py recipe (policy plan, H8/H15 horizons, 2x execution noise, perception error). model_S2S = model_OIL fine-tuned 3000 steps, lr x0.3 (as model_OIL), batches 1/2 shifted-physics data and 1/6 each oil_v1 / cf_v1 / closed-loop data (co-training against forgetting rare dynamics). Only the dynamics network is trained. O_MAX recalibrated label-free with eval/cbf_calibrate.py (same 300 development decisions)
stage0_gap: descriptive: (a) HOLD10/HOLD30 latent prediction error of model_OIL on shifted-physics futures (from 60 random decisions of the evaluation episodes, 8 futures each) vs normal-physics futures (closedloop_v1 val); (b) model_OIL fork_3x on the evaluation episodes: safe alarm rate and topples warned >= 3 chunks ahead, next to the normal-physics reference (paired_record_scl, results/jenga/monrep_protocol.json)
primary: evaluation episodes, deployed fork_3x rule (h_plan < min(h_hold, log2 4) or o > O_MAX, each model with its own label-free O_MAX), eval/margin_check.py decisions (10 chunks before each topple + every 4th safe episode), same 64 futures and seeds for both models: share of topple episodes warned >= 3 chunks ahead, model_S2S minus model_OIL, paired over topple episodes, one-sided 95% lower bound (bootstrap 10000, seed 20261124) > 0, AND model_S2S safe alarm rate <= model_OIL's + 2 pp
secondary: latent error drop on shifted futures (adaptation success) and change on normal-physics futures (forgetting); relative-spread rule at matched alarm rates; AUC of h for topple within 1-3 / 4-6 chunks
next: if PRIMARY passes: closed-loop filter test in the shifted physics (adopted 3x filter with model_OIL vs with model_S2S), pre-registered separately
